<style>/* Copyright Proa Labs, Inc. */
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 */

/* Nike Showcase — CSS based on Nike.com Podium Design System */

:root {
  --nike-text-primary: #111111;
  --nike-text-secondary: #707072;
  --nike-text-badge: #9E3500;
  --nike-bg-primary: #FFFFFF;
  --nike-bg-loading: #F5F5F5;
  --nike-border: #E5E5E5;
  --nike-border-swatch: rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.15);
  --nike-grey-100: #F5F5F5;
  --nike-grey-200: #E5E5E5;
  --nike-grey-400: #CCCCCC;
}

*,
*::before,
*::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

body.nike-page {
  font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
  background: var(--nike-bg-primary);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

/* ── Top bar ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-topbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  height: 36px;
  padding: 0 36px;
  background: var(--nike-grey-100);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
}

.nike-topbar a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.nike-topbar__brands {
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
  align-items: center;
}

.nike-topbar__brands a {
  min-height: 24px;
  padding: 4px 0;
}

.nike-topbar__links {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0;
  align-items: center;
}

.nike-topbar__links a {
  padding: 0 9px;
}

.nike-topbar__sep {
  color: var(--nike-grey-400);
  font-size: 14px;
}

/* ── Header / Nav ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  height: 60px;
  padding: 0 36px;
  background: var(--nike-bg-primary);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nike-border);
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 100;
}

.nike-logo svg {
  display: block;
}

.nike-nav {
  display: flex;
  gap: 24px;
  align-items: center;
}

.nike-nav a {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 4px 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
}

.nike-nav a:hover {
  border-bottom-color: var(--nike-text-primary);
}

.nike-header__actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: center;
}

.nike-search {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--nike-grey-100);
  border-radius: 100px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  height: 40px;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 180px;
}

.nike-search svg {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.nike-search span {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
}

/* ── Page layout ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-page-container {
  max-width: 1920px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 48px;
}

.nike-page-header {
  padding: 24px 0 12px;
}

.nike-page-title {
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
}

.nike-results-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 12px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nike-border);
}

.nike-results-count {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
}

.nike-sort {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 16px;
}

.nike-sort-label {
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
}

.nike-sort-value {
  font-weight: 500;
}

.nike-layout {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0;
  padding-top: 4px;
}

/* ── Filter sidebar ──────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-filters {
  width: 260px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding-right: 24px;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--nike-border);
}

.nike-filter-group {
  padding: 16px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nike-border);
}

.nike-filter-group__title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 500;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
}

.nike-filter-group__title svg {
  transition: transform 0.2s;
}

.nike-filter-group.collapsed .nike-filter-group__title {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.nike-filter-group.collapsed .nike-filter-group__title svg {
  transform: rotate(-90deg);
}

.nike-filter-group.collapsed .nike-filter-item,
.nike-filter-group.collapsed .nike-filter-colors {
  display: none;
}

.nike-filter-group__count {
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
  font-size: 14px;
}

.nike-filter-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 6px 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
}

.nike-checkbox {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--nike-text-primary);
  border-radius: 4px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.nike-checkbox.is-checked {
  background: var(--nike-text-primary);
}

.nike-checkbox.is-checked::after {
  content: "";
  display: block;
  width: 10px;
  height: 6px;
  border-left: 2px solid white;
  border-bottom: 2px solid white;
  transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(1px, -1px);
}

.nike-filter-colors {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 4px 0;
}

.nike-filter-color {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid var(--nike-border-swatch);
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* ── Product grid ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-grid {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  padding-left: 24px;
}

.nike-grid__items {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 4px 16px;
}

@media (max-width: 1200px) {
  .nike-grid__items {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .nike-topbar {
    display: none;
  }
  .nike-header {
    padding: 0 16px;
    height: 48px;
  }
  .nike-logo svg {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
  }
  .nike-nav {
    display: none;
  }
  .nike-search {
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0 10px;
  }
  .nike-search span {
    display: none;
  }
  .nike-grid__items {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 4px 6px;
  }
  .nike-filters {
    display: none;
  }
  .nike-grid {
    padding-left: 0;
  }
  .nike-page-container {
    padding: 0 12px;
  }
  .nike-page-title {
    font-size: 20px;
  }
  .nike-results-bar {
    font-size: 14px;
  }
  .nike-card {
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }
  .nike-footer {
    padding: 24px 16px 16px;
  }
  .nike-footer__cols {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 24px;
  }
  .nike-disclaimer {
    padding: 16px;
  }
}

/* ── Product card ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-card {
  margin-bottom: 48px;
}

.nike-card__link {
  display: block;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
}

.nike-card__img-wrap {
  background: var(--nike-bg-loading);
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.nike-card__img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.nike-card__info {
  padding: 12px 0 0;
}

.nike-card__messaging {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--nike-text-badge);
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.nike-card__title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.nike-card__subtitle {
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.nike-card__price {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
  margin-top: 4px;
}

/* ── Colorway swatches ───────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-card__swatches {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 8px 0 4px;
}

.nike-swatch {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 0.8px solid var(--nike-border-swatch);
}

.nike-card__color-count {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
  padding: 2px 0 4px;
}

/* ── Footer ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-footer {
  background: var(--nike-text-primary);
  color: #7E7E7E;
  padding: 40px 48px 24px;
  margin-top: 60px;
}

.nike-footer__cols {
  display: flex;
  gap: 80px;
  margin-bottom: 40px;
}

.nike-footer__col h4,
.nike-footer__heading {
  color: #FFF;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.nike-footer__col a {
  display: block;
  color: #7E7E7E;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 2;
}

.nike-footer__bottom {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding-top: 16px;
  border-top: 1px solid #333;
  font-size: 11px;
}

.nike-footer__bottom a {
  color: #7E7E7E;
  text-decoration: none;
  margin-left: 16px;
}

/* ── Disclaimer ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-disclaimer {
  padding: 20px 48px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
  background: var(--nike-grey-100);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.nike-disclaimer strong {
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
}

.nike-disclaimer a {
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
/* ── Product Detail Page (PDP) ────────────────────────────  */
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.nike-pdp {
  max-width: 1440px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 48px 60px;
}

/* ── Breadcrumbs ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-pdp__breadcrumbs {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 16px 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
}

.nike-pdp__breadcrumbs a {
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.nike-pdp__breadcrumbs a:hover {
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.nike-pdp__breadcrumb-sep {
  color: var(--nike-grey-400);
  font-size: 12px;
}

/* ── Hero (image + info) ──────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-pdp__hero {
  display: flex;
  gap: 40px;
  padding-bottom: 48px;
}

.nike-pdp__gallery {
  flex: 0 0 55%;
  max-width: 55%;
  background: var(--nike-bg-loading);
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.nike-pdp__main-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.nike-pdp__info {
  flex: 0 0 45%;
  max-width: 45%;
  padding-top: 8px;
}

/* ── Product info ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-pdp__title {
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.3;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.nike-pdp__subtitle {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

/* ── Price ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-pdp__price {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.nike-pdp__current-price {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
}

.nike-pdp__original-price {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
  text-decoration: line-through;
}

.nike-pdp__discount {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #9E3500;
}

/* ── Color selector ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-pdp__color-section {
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.nike-pdp__color-name {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.nike-pdp__colors {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.nike-pdp__color-chip {
  width: 80px;
  height: 80px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: var(--nike-bg-loading);
}

.nike-pdp__color-chip img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.nike-pdp__color-chip:hover {
  border-color: var(--nike-grey-400);
}

.nike-pdp__color-chip.selected {
  border-color: var(--nike-text-primary);
}

/* ── Size selector ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-pdp__size-section {
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.nike-pdp__size-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.nike-pdp__size-label {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
}

.nike-pdp__size-guide {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.nike-pdp__size-guide:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.nike-pdp__sizes {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}

.nike-pdp__size {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 48px;
  border: 1px solid var(--nike-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--nike-bg-primary);
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: inherit;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}

.nike-pdp__size:hover:not(.disabled) {
  border-color: var(--nike-text-primary);
}

.nike-pdp__size.disabled {
  color: #767676;
  background: var(--nike-bg-loading);
  cursor: not-allowed;
  border-color: var(--nike-bg-loading);
}

.nike-pdp__size.selected {
  background: var(--nike-text-primary);
  color: #fff;
  border-color: var(--nike-text-primary);
}

/* ── Buttons ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-pdp__btn-bag {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 100%;
  height: 60px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 30px;
  background: var(--nike-text-primary);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-family: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  transition: opacity 0.15s;
}

.nike-pdp__btn-bag:hover {
  opacity: 0.8;
}

.nike-pdp__btn-fav {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  width: 100%;
  height: 60px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--nike-border);
  border-radius: 30px;
  background: var(--nike-bg-primary);
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-family: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}

.nike-pdp__btn-fav:hover {
  border-color: var(--nike-text-primary);
}

/* ── Shipping ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-pdp__shipping {
  padding-top: 8px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--nike-border);
}

.nike-pdp__shipping-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
}

.nike-pdp__shipping-row svg {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 1px;
}

.nike-pdp__shipping-row a {
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.nike-pdp__shipping-row p {
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
  font-size: 14px;
}

/* ── Sections ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-pdp__section {
  padding: 40px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--nike-border);
}

.nike-pdp__section-title {
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.nike-pdp__description {
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
  max-width: 720px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.nike-pdp__reason {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
  font-style: italic;
}

/* ── Benefits ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-pdp__benefits {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 24px;
}

.nike-pdp__benefit-card {
  padding: 24px;
  background: var(--nike-grey-100);
  border-radius: 12px;
}

.nike-pdp__benefit-title {
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.nike-pdp__benefit-desc {
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
}

/* ── What's New ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-pdp__whats-new {
  list-style: disc;
  padding-left: 20px;
  max-width: 720px;
}

.nike-pdp__whats-new li {
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
  padding: 2px 0;
}

/* ── Product Details ───────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-pdp__details {
  max-width: 520px;
}

.nike-pdp__detail-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 10px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nike-border);
  font-size: 16px;
}

.nike-pdp__detail-row dt {
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
}

.nike-pdp__detail-row dd {
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
  text-align: right;
  max-width: 300px;
}

/* ── Reviews ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-pdp__rating-summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.nike-pdp__stars {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
}

.nike-pdp__avg-rating {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
}

.nike-pdp__reviews {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 24px;
}

.nike-pdp__review-card {
  padding: 24px;
  border: 1px solid var(--nike-border);
  border-radius: 12px;
}

.nike-pdp__review-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.nike-pdp__review-date {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
}

.nike-pdp__review-title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.nike-pdp__review-body {
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--nike-text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.nike-pdp__review-author {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--nike-text-primary);
}

/* ── Recommended carousel ──────────────────────────────────── */
.nike-pdp__recommended {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  padding-bottom: 16px;
}

.nike-pdp__recommended::-webkit-scrollbar {
  height: 4px;
}

.nike-pdp__recommended::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--nike-grey-400);
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.nike-pdp__rec-card {
  flex: 0 0 240px;
  scroll-snap-align: start;
}

.nike-pdp__rec-link {
  display: block;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
}

.nike-pdp__rec-img-wrap {
  background: var(--nike-bg-loading);
